title: Section 2(7) - Consumer
summary: A consumer buys goods or hires services for consideration, generally for personal use and not for resale or commercial purpose.

title: Section 2(10) - Defect
summary: Defect means a fault, imperfection or shortcoming in the quality, quantity, purity or standard of goods required by law or contract.

title: Section 2(11) - Deficiency
summary: Deficiency means a fault, imperfection, shortcoming or inadequacy in the quality or manner of performance of a service required by law or contract.

title: Section 2(47) - Unfair trade practice
summary: Unfair trade practice includes specified deceptive or unfair methods used to promote the sale or supply of goods or services.

title: Section 34 - Jurisdiction of District Commission
summary: The District Commission has jurisdiction to entertain complaints within the pecuniary limits prescribed by the Act and rules.

title: Section 35 - Manner of complaint
summary: A complaint may be filed by a consumer in the manner prescribed before the appropriate Consumer Commission.

title: Section 39 - Reliefs
summary: The District Commission may grant relief including repair, replacement, refund, compensation and discontinuance of an unfair practice where justified.

title: Section 69 - Limitation period
summary: A complaint should ordinarily be filed within two years from the date on which the cause of action arose, subject to condonation for sufficient cause.

title: 2021 Rules Rule 3 - Pecuniary jurisdiction
summary: District Commission: consideration paid up to Rs. 50 lakh; State Commission: above Rs. 50 lakh up to Rs. 2 crore; National Commission: above Rs. 2 crore.
